notes.title: Lumines Arise Drops this Fall on Steam
notes.content:
Enhance, the award-winning game developer and publisher behind Rez Infinite and Tetris® Effect: Connected, announced today its latest title, Lumines Arise. Revealed during the opening of the PlayStation State of Play broadcast, the announce trailer offered a first glimpse into the world of Lumines Arise, set to launch in Fall 2025 on PlayStation 5 with optional PS VR2 support and PC via Steam with optional PC VR support.

Available to wishlist now on:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2370000/Lumines_Arise

Check out the Lumines Arise Announce Trailer.
[previewyoutube=XHUWdasJYrw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]ABOUT LUMINES ARISE[/h2]
A mind-blowing, fiendishly addictive reinvention of the puzzle classic Lumines from the creators of Tetris Effect: Connected, where sound pulses through your body, mind, and every block you place, triggering dazzling visuals synched to the driving beat of an infectious, eclectic soundtrack.

Journey through over 30 stages of synesthetic sensory wonderlands, everything from lush jungles to buzzing Tokyo streets to more surreal experiences, matching blocks and crafting insane combos with the all-new Burst mechanic. Mix it up with a variety of other single-player modes and challenges, or test your mettle against friends or strangers in online multiplayer.

Whether you’re looking to get hyped up or chill out, new to the series or a veteran, have an hour to kill or just five minutes, want to play solo, with friends, or challenge strangers, or play in optional VR or stunning 4K, Lumines Arise is the ultimate puzzle game.

[b]Simple Gameplay, Tons of Depth[/b]
Lumines Arise is easy to pick up and play, but has incredible depth that’s harder to master. Players manipulate 2x2 blocks of two colors that fall from the top of the screen, aiming to create Squares of a single color/type. A Timeline sweeps across the playfield to the beat of the music, clearing completed Squares and generating points.

[b]Embark On A Journey[/b]
Every stop on the over 30-stage single-player journey evokes a different and complex emotional response. From lush jungles, oceans teeming with life and snakes preparing to strike, to more electronic frontiers like the bustling streets of Tokyo and the endless expanse of outer space.

[b]Ready To Burst[/b]
Trigger the new Burst mechanic to stop a matched Square from clearing. Build it as large as you can until time runs out. When the Timeline starts clearing again, enjoy the show as screen-clearing combos rack up massive points.

[b]Put Yourself Out There[/b]
Customize your player avatar from the largest selection of options the series has ever offered. It’s a great way to express yourself and your personality when setting off on your in-game journey.

[b]Plug In, Vibe Out[/b]
Let the electrifying soundtrack by Hydelic, acclaimed composer of Tetris Effect: Connected and Rez Infinite’s Area X, take you to new depths of immersion. You’ll want to throw on a pair of your favorite headphones for maximum effectiveness. Use the Playlist feature to create a mix of stages with your favorite tracks or to set a specific mood.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32966245/444c4791357b01f73df515b397031f93c2d1593c.jpg[/img]

[h2]LUMINES ARISE AT SUMMER GAME FEST PLAY DAYS[/h2]
Summer Game Fest Play Days attendees will have the exclusive opportunity to go hands-on with Lumines Arise in Los Angeles, CA, from June 7-9, 2025. 

Stay tuned for more updates and impressions by following your favorite gaming news outlets and creators.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32966245/65df17782405b99a4366ff39c6ea3af6824cd9f9.jpg[/img]
[h2]LUMINES ARISE SOUNDTRACK SINGLE “ONLY HUMAN”[/h2]

If you like the music from the trailer, get a sneak peek of the album by listening to the first single release, “Only Human” by Hydelic, the music unit behind the sounds of Tetris Effect: Connected and Rez Infinite (Area X). Available now on Bandcamp! Stream everywhere, including Spotify and Apple Music soon! 

For the latest official updates on Lumines Arise, visit [url=https://lumines.game]lumines.game[/url], sign up for the newsletter, or join the Enhance community on [url=https://discord.gg/enhance]Discord[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/enhance-experience.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/enhanceexperience/]YouTube[/url], [url=https://x.com/enhance_exp]X[/url], or [url=https://www.instagram.com/enhance_experience]Instagram[/url]!

notes.title: Celebrating 10 Years of Enhance!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43005846/bc313fba6256fb202dc9e08dec40cbf36fbb0ffc.jpg[/img]

[h1]Presenting Sounds & Visions: Enhance at 10[/h1]

Happy 10th anniversary to us!

Formed in 2014 by visionary Tetsuya Mizuguchi, Enhance is synonymous with transcendent interactive experiences that blur the line between video games, art, sound, and design. From the pulsing techno space-scapes of Rez Infinite to the expansive, ever—evolving visuals and challenge of Tetris® Effect: Connected and games like Lumines Remastered, and HUMANITY, Enhance occupies a wholly unique place in the culture of interactive entertainment.

To mark the 10 year anniversary, we are collaborating with Cook and Becker and Lost In Cult Records to present SOUNDS & VISIONS: ENHANCE AT 10—a celebration of the sights, sounds, works and stories that have defined the first decade of our company.

Presented here for the first time are the extensive musical archives, in-depth oral histories and future visions of Enhance—brought to life in a limited edition collection.

The Sounds and Visions: Enhance at 10 collection offers two unique boxed sets, each with its own special content. These sets can be purchased individually or together. Both sets are available to pre-order exclusively at cookandbecker.com until December 10, 2024.
